sources.entry: Repose - Menu bar break timer that dims your screen and pauses during calls. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/fikrikarim/repose) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]
Repose - Break reminder for macOS that automatically pauses during meetings.

summary.one_liner: Repose is a free, open-source macOS menu bar break timer that dims the screen for rest breaks and pauses automatically when the camera or mic is in use.
summary.what_it_does: Lives in the macOS menu bar and counts down a work interval (5–60 minutes, configurable), then dims the screen with a reminder to look away for a break of 20 seconds to 5 minutes, after which the cycle restarts. It detects active calls by checking hardware directly via CoreMediaIO (cameras) and CoreAudio (microphones), so the timer pauses during meetings without calendar integration or app-specific setup. It pauses when there is no keyboard or mouse activity for 5 minutes and resets to a full work cycle on return, but keeps running during passive video watching. All controls (pause, resume, restart, settings) are in the menu, with no separate preferences window. Updates are delivered automatically through Sparkle.
use_cases: remind myself to rest my eyes while working
break reminder that doesn't interrupt video calls
pomodoro-style work and rest intervals on a Mac
menu bar countdown timer for focus sessions
stop break reminders from popping up during meetings
how_to_run: Download the latest DMG from the project's releases, open it, and drag Repose to Applications.
Build from source: git clone the repository and cd into repose.
notable: Detects meetings by checking camera and mic hardware activity rather than calendars or specific apps
Pauses after 5 minutes of no keyboard or mouse input and resets the cycle on return
Keeps timing during passive video watching so breaks still happen
Entire interface lives in the menu bar with no preferences window
Free and open source under MIT
caveats: Building from source requires Xcode 15+ and Homebrew-installed XcodeGen
keywords: timer that pauses on video call
